name: NHTSA Standing General Order Crash Reporting
update_frequency: Monthly data release and regulatory updates
known_limitations: SGO crash data is important safety evidence, but NHTSA warns that records may be incomplete, duplicated, redacted, non-normalized, and dependent on reporting-entity awareness.
automation_notes: Track data download links, amended orders, archive records, and NHTSA data-limitations notes before AV safety interpretation.
notes: Critical source for ADS and Level 2 ADAS incident evidence.
